QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_12

question.text: What is the CURRENT GST rate applicable on management fees charged by an Investment Manager to an AIF in India?

explanation.text: The Logic: Ch 9.1 and Example 9.6: Management fees and Trusteeship fees attract 18% GST. Similarly, fees paid to external service providers (custodians, auditors, fund administrators) attract 18% GST. The Trap: Option D is wrong — AIF mgmt services are not GST-exempt. Option B is the composition/common goods rate. Option C was the prior rate on some services pre-2017 rationalisation. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-A/B and XXI-B all test this 18% rate; Compliance exams (III-A) go deeper on input tax credit. Manager's Pro-Tip: AIFs typically cannot recover GST as input credit because they don't provide output services — so GST is a dead cost. When negotiating fee rates with LPs, quote 'all-in including GST' to avoid disputes later.
